title: Magnitude-stratified cardiac deceleration capacity: an exploratory incremental cross-database test
abstract: Magnitude-stratified deceleration capacity changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by -0.00976 (joint source/target record bootstrap 95% [-0.02412, 0.00082]) beyond conventional HRV and DC/AC. Incremental benefit was not established in this exploratory dataset comparison.
